sets.name: Stormline
sets.description: Fast pursuit: critical hits, movement and cheaper abilities.

sets.name: Null Choir
sets.description: Sustain your crew with healing, energy recovery and shields.

sets.name: Sunbreaker
sets.description: Hold your ground with health, armor and shield capacity.

sets.name: Iron Witness
sets.description: Fortress shoulders, hydraulic claws and ground anchors for surviving close combat.

items.name: Road visor
items.description: A single luminous slit beneath an armored brow; twin antenna fins.

items.name: Relay mask
items.description: Split optics, a vented faceplate, and square receiver pods.

items.name: Storm eye
items.description: One oversized optic framed by a stepped sensor cage.

items.name: Choir antlers
items.description: Branching signal prongs above a sealed, faceless shell.

items.name: Solar crown
items.description: Five gold-tipped blades rise around a three-eyed ceremonial helm.

items.name: Freight plates
items.description: Broad fenders with inset running lights and layered crash rails.

items.name: Pursuit fenders
items.description: Swept shoulder fairings with exposed wheel hubs.

items.name: Storm turbines
items.description: Twin circular intake housings with luminous turbine centers.

items.name: Choir spires
items.description: Unequal towers of layered armor and bright signal needles.

items.name: Solar bastions
items.description: Fortress pauldrons, solar crests, and three gilded vanes per side.

items.name: Split cell
items.description: Two luminous engine windows divided by a reinforced keel.

items.name: Freight grille
items.description: An industrial radiator with five horizontal armored slats.

items.name: Storm reactor
items.description: A circular iris reactor held inside four massive locking jaws.

items.name: Choir heart
items.description: Three staggered energy shards above a black segmented cage.

items.name: Solar heart
items.description: An eight-spoked solar engine with a brilliant exposed center.

items.name: Piston gauntlets
items.description: Twin external pistons, reinforced knuckles, and bolted wrist guards.

items.name: Blade cuffs
items.description: Low-profile guards with swept outer blades and thin energy seams.

items.name: Storm coils
items.description: Three luminous induction bands wrap each armored forearm.

items.name: Choir talons
items.description: Three long mechanical talons extend from layered wrist shells.

items.name: Solar hammers
items.description: Heavy hammer housings with radial energy studs and gold impact plates.

items.name: Road greaves
items.description: Split shin fairings, knee lamps, and long armored toes.

items.name: Freight treads
items.description: Wide track guards with exposed tread blocks down each calf.

items.name: Storm striders
items.description: Calf-mounted thruster pods and forked knee fins.

items.name: Choir stilts
items.description: Long side spars and stepped crystalline knee guards.

items.name: Solar sabatons
items.description: Overlapping gold-edged scales and broad ceremonial heel spurs.

items.name: Vector fins
items.description: Two swept stabilizer panels mounted on an exposed spine.

items.name: Freight stacks
items.description: Twin exhaust stacks with ribbed cooling collars and a central tank.

items.name: Storm wings
items.description: Four interceptor wings with luminous leading edges.

items.name: Choir array
items.description: Six staggered transmitter blades fan from a dark spinal rail.

items.name: Solar eclipse
items.description: A monumental segmented sun ring with four outward solar blades.

items.name: Ghost prism
items.description: Three floating optical plates surround an empty face. Recovered survey lenses still remember the people they were ordered to erase.

hunt.label: Defeat Orphaned surveyor patrols, level 0+
hunt.hint: Surveyors patrol the streets around Afterlight Commons. Only the credited killer advances this hunt.

items.name: Witness ramparts
items.description: Tall shield walls with amber witness windows. Every plate carries a debt that someone refused to collect.

hunt.label: Defeat Debt warden patrols, level 20+
hunt.hint: Hunt wardens in the Pale Basin or the higher city tiers. Only the credited killer advances this hunt.

items.name: Ghost lattice
items.description: An open diamond cage surrounds a suspended cyan cell. The Ninth Bell left an interval in its rhythm for a heart that was no longer there.

hunt.label: Complete The Ninth Bell
hunt.hint: Solo expedition, level 0+. Finish the final decision to advance; either ending counts.

items.name: Witness clamps
items.description: Hydraulic pincers fold around armored wrists, with amber pressure gauges. Salvaged from machinery once used to dismantle occupied homes.

hunt.label: Defeat Wirejack patrols, level 10+
hunt.hint: Find Wirejacks beyond the starter streets, in the city and Pale Basin. Only the credited killer advances this hunt.

items.name: Witness anchors
items.description: Outrigger heels and immense split knee shields. These anchors held the rain court in place long enough for the last witness to speak.

hunt.label: Complete A Trial for the Rain
hunt.hint: Three-player expedition, level 18+. Every completing crew member gets a personal roll, whichever ending wins.

items.name: Ghost orbit
items.description: Four cyan satellites bracket a broken diamond halo. Their missing fifth signal is still arriving from the harbor at the end of tomorrow.

hunt.label: Complete The Harbor at the End of Tomorrow
hunt.hint: Eight-player expedition, level 50+. Every completing crew member gets a personal roll, whichever ending wins.
